rules.composition: Consistent human-relative scale, ground pivots and painted edges; no flat SVG/CSS shapes as world props.
rules.assetSourcePolicy: Original/generated/commissioned art with rights and reviewer evidence

rules.verification: A ready incident requires real asset files, visual delta, alt descriptions and review evidence
